title: Rav Sheshet of Kartiza
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Megillah 21b](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.21b.5): he came to Rav Ashi’s house and recited the blessings M-N-Ch. Hyman reports that [the Rif](https://www.sefaria.org/Rif_Megillah.12a.4) and Dikdukei Soferim read: “he came before Rav Sheshet.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Rav Sheshet of Katarzya and says he came before Rav Ashi and used the order M-N-Ch for the three blessings.
The linked Rif calls him Rav Sheshet of Maqatronia and says he came before Rav Sheshet. Hyman also attributes the latter reading to Dikdukei Soferim.
